description: Lets a manually typed Governed SDD Proceed trigger prepare and verify its own exact task worktree when no coordinator launch inputs were supplied.
delta: Coordinator-launched workers retain the existing prepare-before-launch and exact-path check contract. A manually typed `Proceed with <TASK-ID>` now determines the primary checkout, runs only `meridian worktree prepare <TASK-ID> --project <primary-checkout> --format json`, then checks the returned worktree before reading task material. A failed prepare or unavailable prepared directory is BLOCKED without fallback to the primary checkout; review and remediation remain coordinator-launched consumers of an existing registered worktree.
verification: upgrade from the previous bounded-worktree-lifecycle and task-worktree-boundary versions installs the manual Proceed rule while preserving consumer-owned text
a locally customized IMPLEMENTATION.md produces a bounded upgrade conflict instead of a silent overwrite
review and remediation procedure files remain byte-identical to their pre-migration versions
python3 scripts/check_repository.py and python3 -m unittest discover -s tests pass
